source_inspection: Parent and source reviewer read retained primary body/captions and visually inspected Figures1/3. DOI/ref18 checked in retained Fried2014 article. SI challenge/error responses are not primary scientific content.
review_process: Parent source/diff review and separately prompted read-only source, representation and adversarial agents on gpt-5.6-sol/ultra. Correlated computational checks, not independent human or experimental validation. Final immutable publication review is recorded separately.

adjudications.objection: A modest Y16S effect might be attributed to retention of its hydroxyl hydrogen bond.
adjudications.decision: Hydroxyl-absent Ala/Gly retain similar moderate turnover. Encode that donor-control discrimination, without equal-mechanism or significance claims.
adjudications.evidence: Kraut2010 Results Rate Effects and Fig2.

adjudications.objection: The analogue structure or water evidence could be transferred to the kinetic single mutants.
adjudications.decision: 3IPT is Y16S/D40N plus equilenin; 19F uses double mutants plus fluoronitrophenolate. No same-construct/ligand or direct turnover-water relation. Source water model stays inferred; unresolved density is not discrete water sites.
adjudications.evidence: Figs3-4, Results X-Ray Structure and 19F NMR, Methods and D40N footnote.

adjudications.objection: Reported reductions could be relabeled as absolute kcat or kcat/KM, or inherit Fig2 SD.
adjudications.decision: Reuse the existing source-reported reduction-factor contract with approximate values and unavailable factor errors. Qualify the reported pattern, not new exact arithmetic. SI remains unacquired.
adjudications.evidence: Main Results and Fig2 caption; acquisition appendix.

adjudications.objection: Signed NMR measurements would be corrupted by the unsigned scalar contract.
adjudications.decision: Keep -136.4 and -134.7ppm as signed structured source evidence. Do not relabel them qualitative, take absolute values, or add a case-specific runtime exception.
adjudications.evidence: Fig4B and 19F Results; existing nonnegative observation contract.

adjudications.objection: The product name and sequencing statement could exceed the acquired source wording.
adjudications.decision: Label product nomenclature as project reading of Fig1A. Restrict DNA confirmation to the source statement about Tyr16-mutant plasmids; no WT/D40N/full-specimen sequence verification.
adjudications.evidence: Visually inspected Fig1A; exact main Methods sentence.

adjudications.objection: The inherited reference18 connection would remain a manual DOI join.
adjudications.decision: Add a structured Fried2014 reference18 relation and bind the existing compiled context. Different5(10)-EST versus5-AND substrates block exact factor/condition/row-lineage transfer.
adjudications.evidence: Retained Fried2014 article ref18/SI TableS2; Kraut2010 Results Rate Effects.

adjudications.objection: The draft treated all transfer axes as experimentally disproved and its projection scope omitted the new selection.
adjudications.decision: Only sidechain nonuniformity is demonstrated. Substrate, analogue and background transfers remain unqualified. Narrow CE-040 to the named panel and include its positive discrimination/model limit in the public projection scope.
adjudications.evidence: Kraut2010 control panel and unmatched experimental contexts; adversarial exact-draft review.
